_comment: Monthly FCA and quarterly QTA (Rs per unit) as reported from NEPRA decisions. FCA is billed 2 months after the fuel month. Verify against the NEPRA notification and edit/add months here. 'proposed' means NEPRA had not decided yet.

2026-06.source: NEPRA decisions as reported in the press (Jun 2026)

2026-07.source: NEPRA notification of 8-9 Jul 2026 (Business Recorder, Profit)

2026-08.source: NEPRA decision of 7 Aug 2026 (Tribune, MEPCO guide)

2026-09.source: NEPRA Decision 04-Sep-2026; QTA notified via S.R.O. 1501(I)/2026 dated 07-Sep-2026; FCA notification S.R.O. 1499(I)/2026
2026-09.notes: QTA notification exempts lifeline, incremental-consumption-package billed units and prepaid consumers; this version models lifeline exemption and flags the other categories as not separately captured.

2026-10.source: CPPA-G request for August 2026 heard by NEPRA on 29-Sep-2026; final notified value must be verified before use
